notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.39
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! See below for details on update v0.13.39:

Update Time: 2025/9/23 15:00 UTC


[olist]
The Difficulty 9 starting Relic Ninth Cosmic Seal has been reworked, and now grants a Health buff to certain Heroes.
[olist]
High Infernal gains Lasting +0/+10 from their first battle when using the hero skill Madness. Grand Arcaness gains Lasting +0/+10 from their first battle when using the hero skill Surge.

This will serve as a fundamental buff mechanic within the game for subsequent runs at different difficulties following changes to archetypes in the latest version.
[/olist]
Enhanced hero High Infernal's variant deck, replacing Less is More with Bloody Strike.

Ardent Knight will no longer appear during the first turn when fighting Mega Shockerel in Mastery Mode.

Enhanced Dolls Gobbo, Leafy, and Skelly. Cards hidden within them will gain +30% Might (Gobbo), +20% Health (Leafy), or +20% Potency (Skelly) at the start of battle. This buff applies to battle only, and does not affect the card's rating.

When Magick Brush is used to Discover pawns, the pawn loses -1 MP cost.

Increased Magman's starting Health from 8 to 9.

Relic Sacred Chalice now buffs Temp Relic cards in your deck as well as in your hand.

Relic Legion Banner's secondary effect triggers when you have ≥15 cards in your deck (previously ≥20).

Relic Sunstone now has the Boost trait.

Empower and Invigorate traits now have effects similar to Boost.

Fixed an issue where complex skill interactions would cause card models to remain in your hand.

Fixed an issue where Magma Drake's skill would cause Enchanted Vines's card to remain on the screen when summoned.

Fixed an issue where you could select 2 Dolls at the same time. This issue was somewhat complex, and could appear when logging in for a first time after an update and selecting a Doll different to the one previously selected.

Fixed an issue where enemy cards obtained through completing events did not have tier II effects.

Fixed an issue where the Relic panel could display Relics in the wrong places when there were multiple Relics.

Fixed multiple issues with UI blocking and trait explanation tooltip locations.

Fixed an issue where negative values could appear in the run summary screen.

Fixed an issue where Dolls could have excessive numbers of Doll traits.

Improved and fixed a number of issues with controllers. Controller support remains in development.
[/olist]


Thank you once again for your feedback!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.38
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! See below for details on update v0.13.38:

Update Time: 2025/9/22 16:00 UTC
[olist]
Doll cards with a minimum score of 251 will appear in Level 5-10 Shops, preventing you from missing out on Doll cards at higher Shop levels.

MP cost of Blizzard Drake's Thunderous Rage hero skill has been reduced from 1 to 0.

Starting Potency of Grand Arcaness's Biting Cold hero skill has been increased from 0 to 2.

Datura's Endless Sacrifice hero skill now triggers at turn start rather than battle start. If you do not have Endless Sacrifice in your hand, it will be added to your hand.

Clarified description of Dragondroid's Assimilation hero skill. The same pawn can only be targeted by the skill once per turn. Added exception logic to prevent Devoted Attendant from repeatedly targeting the same pawn; the skill will fail if it does.

Increased Might of boss Datura. Fixed an issue where Datura would add Donation Boxes to your hand outside of battle start.

Provisionally improved positioning of boss Midnight Augur in Mastery Mode, and swapped Ardent Knight for Waxwyrm.

Reduced chance that Shifty Merchant will grant Midas Touch.

Local backup saves will now be uploaded to cloud storage in order to make restoring lost saves easier.

Added 1600x900 resolution setting.

Fixed an issue where Doll cards purchased from the shop could disappear after saving and loading.

Fixed issues with Quick Restart after Shapeshift.

Fixed an issue where the Fatigue damage panel would remain in place under certain circumstances.

Fixed an issue where hero skills' starting Potency would not be displayed outside of battle.

Fixed an issue where boss Shrine Maiden would trigger the Relic Crystal Skull when destroying Snail Looter with her skill.

Fixed an issue where Pass Through Flames's values would not be updated if drawn the turn after being attacked by enemies.

Fixed an issue where Shadow Lancer would erroneously appear in Resonate/Shield Packs.

Fixed an issue where right-clicking on preview cards with the magnifying glass icon would not display creatable cards during events.

Improved sound quality.

Provisionally improved Relic tooltip out-of-bounds issues.
[/olist]
Thank you for your feedback —we'll keep working hard to make Cubic Cosmos even better!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.33-v.0.13.37
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! See below for details on the latest updates.


v.0.13.33
Update Time: September 19, 2025



1. Fixed an issue where Astral Summons would cause pawns to attack themselves under certain circumstances if their target had disappeared.

2. Fixed text box out-of-bounds issues for Relic tooltips in 16:10 and 16:9 aspect ratios.

3. Fixed an issue where Relics would not display tooltips when viewed via battle code replay.

4. Fixed an issue with the description of Alchemy: it does not only take effect while in your hand, but also when in your deck or graveyard.

5. Fixed an issue where skills that detect the amount of cards in your deck would not take effect as intended when viewing battle code replays.

6. Fixed an issue where Ratillery's skill would not trigger visual effects.

7. Fixed certain controller issues.


v0.13.34
Update Time: September 20, 2025

1. Fixed an issue that could cause save loss on login.


v0.13.35-v0.13.36
Update Time: September 21, 2025



1. New Features

Quick Restart: In Level 1 of a run, this option can be selected from the menu by pressing Escape, and will restart your run without requiring you to exit and restart.

2. Stage and Difficulty Changes

Act II Difficulty 7-10:

Reduced attributes of enemies in the first stage of Level 1.

Slightly reduced attributes of enemies in the second stage of Level 1.

3. Enemy Changes

Slightly reduced attributes of enemy Magnetortoise.

Slightly reduced attributes of enemy Ardent Knight.

4. Boss Changes

Boss Mega Shockerel's skill damage is now linked to Might, and will deal higher damage when attacking allies.

5. Bug Fixes and Improvements

Fixed an issue that would leave you unable to select cards after a stage began, and added a backstop measure: if you are unable to select cards, return to the main menu and re-enter the stage to fix it.

Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash when playing multiple Auto cards as the second wave of enemies arrived.

Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash if Hourglass and Chamelizard · Yellow were activated in sequence.

Fixed an issue where Chamelizard · Yellow's skills would be disabled after transforming.

Fixed an issue where Stimulating Wisdom would not affect Shadowflower after transforming.

Fixed an issue where Stormchaser and Silverlight Keeper would affect enemies.

Fixed an issue where Spirit Echo II would fail to activate.

Fixed an issue where the hero skill Sacrifice would leave you unable to right-click to view creatable cards.

Fixed an issue where Rend Asunder would erroneously appear in Auto/Reload Packs.

Fixed an issue where Shadow Dragon would absorb Might when playing Astral Summons.

Cards such as Mad Dance and Whirlwind Strike that deal \[50% Might] damage now deal a minimum of 1 damage, and will no longer deal 0 damage.

6. Relic Changes

Relic Boxes are now weighted according to different heroes. Reduced or eliminated the chance that Relic Boxes will contain Relics that are not applicable to your current hero's class.


v0.13.37
Update Time: September 21, 2025



1. Fixed an issue where boss Grand Arcaness' Pierce skill would be retained from her first phase after transforming, allowing her to one-shot you.

2. Boss Shadow Dragon will no longer trigger its Might absorption skill in the first turn, preventing pawns that are Auto-played at the start of battle from being affected.

3. Reduced starting Health of boss Mega Channeler.

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.32
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts!

See below for details of fixes and improvements in version 0.13.32.


🔧Bug Fixes[olist]
Fixed an issue where using the "Delete Save" feature would cause cloud save uploads to fail.

Fixed an issue that could cause cloud save uploads to fail in a particular critical situation.

Fixed an issue where using cards like Enchanted Vines to Discover and select cards could cause the "End Turn" button to stop working following complex skill activation chains.

Fixed an issue where 2 cards would remain locked upon reaching Level 25. They will now be unlocked upon logging in if your level is high enough.

Fixed an issue where hero Health values shown on cards such as Convalescence would not be updated in real time.

Fixed crash issues caused by certain skill activation chains as a precautionary measure.

Fixed certain controller issues.
[/olist]🔧Feature and Experience Improvements[olist]
Volume is now set to 50% by default for new game starts.

 Improved card ordering for the deck selection screen, making arrangements neater.
[/olist]


We encourage you to carry on reporting issues and submitting feedback so we can continue to make the game even better!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Patch Notes v0.13.31
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts!

See below for details on update v0.13.31.


🔧Bug Fixes[olist]
Fixed an issue where Daily Challenge bosses would be the same every day. They now rotate on a daily basis.

Fixed an issue where cards in your hand could not be selected when Shadowflower died after being Auto-played.

Fixed an issue where cards could not be selected after playing Ready and Willing and Mirrored Pool sequentially.

Fixed an issue where cards could not be selected when summoning Enchanted Vines after Auto-playing Ars Goetia.

Fixed an issue where Strength Rune was mislabeled as Legendary Pack in the Shop.

Fixed an issue where consecutively casting the hero skill Assimilation would cause Hero Health to jump between two values.

Fixed an issue where restarting the game under certain circumstances would cause the Fatigue damage panel to persist.

Fixed an issue where playing Overcharge would change card ratings in the Codex to values that exceeded the size of their text boxes.

Fixed erroneous 'x2' labels for certain cards' Potency trait descriptions.

Fixed an issue where Supercharged Golem's Resonate effect would only activate for 3 MP sorceries rather than 2 MP sorceries.

Temporarily disabled the feature where other players' cards have a chance to appear in the Shop at Difficulty 9 and Difficulty 10. Cards with very high attributes now have a chance to appear instead.

Fixed error messages regarding reuse of special effects in certain circumstances.
[/olist]⚙️Interface and System Improvements[olist]
Changed the location of the Resolution option in the Settings menu to prevent it from being covered up by tooltip text.

Added a mouseover tooltip to indicate that Act 3 is currently unavailable. It will be added at a later date.

Added debug logs to help investigate crashes caused by sequential skill activation in certain circumstances.

Fixed an issue where certain cards would be covered up in 16:10 aspect ratio.
[/olist]
Thanks for your feedback. We'll keep on fixing any bugs you find!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Update v0.13.30
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts!

Current Version
v0.13.30


🛠 Fixes and Changes[olist]
Fixed an issue where the game would crash after the first turn in certain circumstances.

Fixed an issue where destroying a Death pawn with Endless Sacrifice would not trigger Death effects like Commander's Saber, which rely on triggering other pawns' Death effects.

Fixed an issue where trying to log in while offline would crash the game.

Fixed an issue where reaching the end of a battle code replay would cause the game to crash in certain circumstances.

Fixed crash issues with controllers.

Improved run failure summary logic. You will no longer auto-save after dying and entering the run failure summary screen. You can press Alt+F4 to restart the battle, or press Escape upon dying to return to the main menu and manage your save from there.

Removed the hero card choice from the Golden Idol event. The card cannot be ascended.

Removed frame rate counter in the top-left corner.
[/olist]


We encourage you to carry on reporting issues and submitting feedback so we can continue to make the game even better!

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Early Access Release September 17!
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! Big news incoming:

🎉 Cubic Cosmos will be released for Early Access on September 17 at 07:00 UTC!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444613/18f4ce1bbef06c2023e354bc1cd684c93057c19c.jpg"]

During the playtest period, we've received a huge amount of feedback from players—both criticism and encouragement—which has been factored into our plans to improve the game for future versions. We'd like to express our heartfelt thanks to all our playtesters and to everyone who played the demo. Your support and feedback have been invaluable to us.



The Early Access version of Cubic Cosmos will contain:

Three major classes

200+ cards

9 playable heroes

Numerous gameplay modes—including tutorial, multiple fixed boss chapters, randomized boss chapters with increasing difficulty, daily challenges, and Mastery Mode (a variant of endless mode)

Achievements system: base achievements and challenge achievements

Cubic Cosmos will launch with a 25% discount, priced under $10 for one week only—so don't miss out! If you like Cubic Cosmos, don't forget to keep sending us your ideas and suggestions, and we'll take them into consideration for future versions.



The demo is still available, so if you still haven't tried it, now's your chance. Your support is crucial to us as we get ready for the big release. So if you enjoyed the demo, please add the game to your wishlist, and feel free to join our official community to get the latest updates, cheer on/torment the dev team, and chat about all things Cubic Cosmos.



We'll be sharing an updated development roadmap soon, so stay tuned!

Cubic Cosmos Team

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Demo Changelog #3
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! Over the past few versions, we've fixed a number of issues affecting the game and made various improvements to overall performance. See below for a list of changes:


Current Version
v0.12.20


Performance Improvements
Fixed an issue where performance would gradually decline after playing the game for long periods.

Improved performance, increasing framerate over sustained playtime.
Fixes
Fixed an issue where the numbers of cards owned would not appear after hiding an event, as well as fixing display issues for cards in your inventory.

Fixed display issues with level objective numbers when fighting Shapeshift bosses.

Fixed an issue with battle codes where using Temp Relics and restarting combat would cause problems.

Fixed an issue where using Abyssal Eye with multiple Auto cards would cause the game to crash upon reloading your deck.

Other Changes
Fatigue damage now takes Shield into account, and will trigger Wound effects.

We're working non-stop to improve the game in response to your feedback. If you encounter any other issues, please share them on our Steam page or Discord. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Next Fest Thanks & Changelog
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts!

Thank you to everyone for your support during Next Fest!

Your feedback and suggestions have driven us to keep working hard, and seeing so many players enjoying the demo has really been a huge encouragement.

Over the past few days, we've continued to polish the game, fixing issues and improving your experience. Here's a summary of the most recent changes:



Current Version: v0.12.17
🔧Recent Updates
Fixed text issues in multiple translations.

Fixed various performance issues, increasing frame rate in a number of situations.

Fixed an issue with battle code errors.

Fixed an issue where choosing between Auto cards with Falsefruit could lead to crashes.

Improved rotation angles for impact animations when projectiles hit targets, providing more natural feedback.

Blocked a number of incompatible buff/debuff trait combinations.

Fixed an issue where clicking a stage quickly in succession would cause enemies not to advance, leading to crashes.

Fixed an issue where attributes increased during a final boss fight would not be saved properly afterward.

Improved Vine Spirit buff projectiles, removing intervals to make effects smoother.


💡 Next Fest Over, Demo Still Available—Updates Are Coming!
Next Fest may be over, but the demo will still be available. Feel free to try out new decks, show off your strongest cards, or recommend Cubic Cosmos to your friends—they might just find their new favorite game!

Thanks once again for your support. We'll continue to work hard polishing the game and adding new content as soon as we can!



Cubic Cosmos Team (currently busting our humps for the next update)

notes.title: Cubic Cosmos Demo Changelog
notes.notes:
Hail, Cosmonauts! Since Next Fest began, we've been working around the clock to fix issues and improve functionality. Thanks to everyone for your support and feedback!

See below for a summary of changes made over the last few days.


Current Version
v0.12.14


System and Feature Improvements
The main menu screen now displays the current version number.

Added a Community Events button to the main menu screen. Press it to visit our community events page, where you could win a product key.

"Repair Save" now only appears on the splash screen to avoid confusion.

Added a share feature for the Doll system (Windows only), allowing you to create and share images.

When changing heroes at the run entry screen, the background will also change to fit the hero.
Combat and Skill Adjustments
Mega Channeler (Boss): Slightly increased initial attributes. Skill changed from "+10% max Health" to "+10% current Health".

Steel Tortoise: Skill category changed to Shatter.

Waxwyrm: Attack slightly weakened.

Shrine Maiden (Boss): Fewer minions.

Gigalodon/Shrine Maiden: Temporarily removed "advance each turn" skills. Related mechanism will be overhauled in future updates.

Auto-Magus: Now begins with an initial Potency stat.
Other Fixes
Fixed an issue where Demonic Ring's effect would not apply to hero skills after Shapeshift.

Fixed an issue with Weald Wraith's description.

Fixed an issue where Sword & Shield's bonus would not be immediately updated after battle ends.

Fixed an issue where the green box effect would not be promptly updated and removed after using Charge Up.

Fixed certain buff bullet effects.

Fixed an issue where using destroyed pawns' skills would cause model clipping.

Fixed an issue where immediately attacking after playing a pawn would cause its background to hover in mid-air.

Fixed an issue where attribute values would be displayed incorrectly mid-Shapeshift.

Fixed an issue where summons' Health would be displayed incorrectly.

Fixed an issue where buff icons would flicker when mousing over cards.

Fixed an issue with overlapping random content for Death/Wound Pack and Auto/Reload Pack.

Fixed an issue where you could still interact with objects in a run while returning to the main menu.

Fixed an issue where unchanged placeholder text might be shown in the battle log.



Thanks to everyone for your support, and your feedback regarding the demo. We'll continue to work hard to improve your gameplay experience. If you encounter any issues, please post your feedback on our Steam community page or in our Discord!

Speaking of community, our community events are underway, and you could win an official product activation code! See here for details:
